scope: Standard two-player duel, original Alice/King Arthur/Medusa/Sinbad and original120 cards, applicable official2025 Excalibur erratum; optional teams, other sets and Adventures excluded.
independence: Read only explicitly enumerated source inputs and candidate, plus generated crops/renders/receipts within this audit directory. No question bank/key/scope document, reader/grades, earlier audits, canonical summary, or parent-context evidence consulted.

checked_claims.detail: Two-player original-fighter scope; components and health limits; hero defeat ends immediately; sidekicks removed; team rules excluded.
Separate 30-card decks, five-card hands, younger 1/older 2, own-zone separate sidekick spaces, Alice size when placed, younger first all correct.
One fighter per space, connecting lines define adjacency, all matching patterned spaces form zone, multi-pattern belongs to all.

checked_claims.claim: Two mandatory actions and hand limit
checked_claims.detail: Actions repeat; mandatory two; excess discarded to seven at turn end only.

Mandatory first draw; optional independent complete moves; friendly passage and enemy blockers; owner-perspective movement; one hand card boosts all fighters by printed BOOST ignoring effect; defeated-fighter card still boosts.
Active fighter must match label; ANY permits surviving sidekick. Medusa as named return destination does not require her to initiate Winged Frenzy.
Legal active fighter/card/target, adjacent melee or ranged shared-zone targeting, simultaneous reveal and optional defense; versatile counts both types.

Immediately, during, result, after-combat cards, other effects, final face-up discard. Defender first at same timing. Mandatory unless optional. Played defeated sidekick effects persist unless duel ended.

checked_claims.claim: Damage, winner, cancellation and immediate loss
checked_claims.detail: Attack minus defense minimum zero; only attack damage determines winner; effects cancel without canceling printed value; hero death precludes pending recovery.
No reshuffle. Each missed individual draw causes two damage to each own fighter; two missing draws cause successive events, with immediate game end taking precedence.
Dial cap; direct placement differs from movement along paths, retains one-fighter space restriction.
All starting health/attacks/move values and full Alice, Arthur, Medusa, Sinbad abilities match originals, subject to applicable2025 Excalibur exception.

2 + number already in discard; 3 produces5. Played Voyage not discarded yet. Home retrieves other discarded Voyages before normal discard then leaves Home itself for subsequent allowance3. Home maneuver BOOST counts its1 and newly discarded Voyage+1.

checked_claims.claim: Six Voyages lacking BOOST cannot pay for BOOST
checked_claims.detail: No printed value distinct from printed zero. October17,2019 designer statement explicitly says omission prevents dumping Voyages. Home exception has B1.
4vs4 causes0; defender wins and moves Jabberwock first, so Jaws has no target in shown final spatial position. Mandatory friendly target rule follows any one fighter.

checked_claims.claim: Current Excalibur rule, historical2021 intent and normal discard
checked_claims.detail: Textless Excalibur cannot have printed effects canceled; ability BOOST survives Feint. Historical January2,2021 designer quote is accurately labeled superseded. Preservation of boost does not return payment to hand or override ordinary final discard.
